profile.name: SiTCP传输层组件
profile.description: 一个非物理的软件通信组件，通过以太网使用 TCP 和 UDP/RBCP 协议与外部实验电子学或 FPGA 寄存器总线通信。它用于初始化连接、读写总线地址、复位缓冲区或 FIFO，并在实验数据采集系统中管理套接字与读出流程。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software communication component that talks over Ethernet using TCP and UDP/RBCP to external lab electronics or FPGA register buses. It is used to initialize connections, read and write bus addresses, reset buffers or FIFOs, and manage sockets and readout flow in experimental data acquisition systems.
